security_review.headline: The scheme guard is load-bearing, not decorative. The reviewer proved against the repo's own zod 4.5.4 that z.url() ACCEPTS javascript:, data:, vbscript: and file:, and that ConferenceSchema.safeParse at google-event.normalizer.ts:169 is the only ingest validation and carries no scheme constraint. Without isJoinableUrl, raw provider-controlled schemes would reach window.open. This feature closes a gap the codebase did not previously cover.
security_review.probe: 42 adversarial URLs run through the exact guard body: no scheme bypass found. Leading/trailing whitespace, C0 controls, embedded newlines, tabs inside the scheme, and mixed case are all correctly blocked because new URL applies the same stripping the browser's own navigation does. Non-ASCII pseudo-whitespace and RTL-override hosts throw and fail closed.

known_limitations: R-1 (a) The join button's bubble-phase stopPropagation is dead code against PointerCaptureBoundary's capture-phase onPointerDownCapture, which runs ancestor-first and takes pointer capture. Real fix is an opt-out for nested interactive controls in packages/web/src/grid/interaction/dom.ts plus the Week and Day adapters -- all OUTSIDE the frozen allowlist.

R-1 (b) CONFIRMED by manual browser check 2026-08-30 (human, dev:web @ localhost:9080): a mouse CLICK on the join glyph opens the event's right-hand details panel and does NOT open the meeting -- symptom (i), the form only. Not symptom (ii): the meeting tab does NOT also open. So the mouse-click join path is non-functional in production. Keyboard activation (Tab -> Enter) DOES open the Meet tab correctly, as predicted -- keyboard fires click on the button directly, no pointerdown, so PointerCaptureBoundary never intercepts.

R-1 (c) CONFIRMED by manual browser check 2026-08-30 (human): a press-and-drag starting on the join glyph MOVES / reschedules the underlying event. Reproducible with a deliberate drag gesture. A pure click (movement < INTERACTION_MOVE_THRESHOLD_PX=25) still does not trip it, but an imprecise click-drag on the 10x10 target does. Correctness / data-integrity defect, not security.

R-1 security status: fails safe. Only isJoinableUrl-validated values can reach window.open, so R-1 cannot cause navigation to an unvalidated URL, cannot change which URL opens, and cannot strip noopener,noreferrer. The security property is orthogonal to R-1, not protected by it.

CI still cannot DETECT R-1. The F-2 packet stopped the suite advertising the false invariant, but only a test rendering inside a real PointerCaptureBoundary and firing pointerDown could catch a regression.

manual_verification_recheck.why_space_works_here: The affordance is a real <button> whose handleKeyDown treats Enter and ' ' identically -- stopPropagation, preventDefault, then window.open. Keyboard activation is handled by the component's own code rather than delegated to native element behaviour. Contrast the CMP-103/flash-agsdk-only arm, which built the affordance as a bare <a> and only stopPropagation'd Space without preventDefault or .click(): there Space activates nothing and the browser's default page-scroll takes over, so that arm fails on two interactions where this one fails on one.
